title: Polperro Cellar Table, Private Dining Experience
summary: Polperro's private dining room below the winery. Six to eight guests, five courses, the latest Polperro and Even Keel cuvees poured by the people who made them.
priceRange: Ticketed, per person (Chef's Menu with matched wines)
suitableFor: Adults 18+; couples; special occasions; serious foodies
accessibilityNotes: Private room accessible, check with venue for specific needs
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Brewery; Stonier Wines; Foxeys Hangout; Red Hill Truffles
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book Cellar Table on a winter Saturday; pair with a morning truffle hunt or afternoon at Red Hill Brewery
editorVerdict: The most exclusive table at Polperro and the room you book when an occasion has to land. Worth the spend.
editorNote:
Six to eight seats, one shared table in the cellar room beneath the winery. Sculptural lighting, five courses from the kitchen, and matched flights of the current Polperro and Even Keel cuvee releases. Available Saturday evenings, by arrangement.

This is the occasion-only Polperro: anniversaries, milestone birthdays, a small group who actually wants to talk about wine while they drink it. Not a date-night casual book. Book three to four weeks ahead minimum.

Make a weekend of it. Truffle hunt at Red Hill Truffles in the morning, lunch at Many Little, the Cellar Table that evening. Stay at Polperro Villas so nobody drives.
